searchText: can you add some tools like custom_flood, tx_spammer and so on for some load? also are you testing pectra? if so, mock/flashbots mev stack doesn't support it yet afaik, mev-rs should work though (but we haven't started mev testing and are still working on regular eip happy path testing) Before we do this I'd like to think how we do this. Last I've seen we simply let clients down for a while. It'd be nice to do things a bit more nasty, not straight out attacks but 1) split the network about 50-50 for a long time 2) simply isolate some clients to not see anything but let their attestations continue on Those two things should be pretty realistic cases that we should be able to deal with

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
can you add some tools like custom_flood, tx_spammer and so on for some load?
also are you testing pectra? if so, mock/flashbots mev stack doesn't support it yet afaik, mev-rs should work though (but we haven't started mev testing and are still working on regular eip happy path testing)

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content:
Before we do this I'd like to think how we do this. Last I've seen we simply let clients down for a while. It'd be nice to do things a bit more nasty, not straight out attacks but
1) split the network about 50-50 for a long time
2) simply isolate some clients to not see anything but let their attestations continue on
